entities.summary: Jean-Louis Marie Georgelin was a French Army general who served as Chief of the Defence Staff from 4 October 2006 to 25 February 2010. From 9 June 2010 until 31 August 2016 he served as Grand Chancellor of the Légion d'honneur, the French national order.
